recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to solid white (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw the outer double-line frame: two concentric rectangles with thin dark-red (#8B0000) outlines (~1.5 pt each), the outer rectangle inset ~1.5% and the inner rectangle inset ~2.5% from the slide edges. 3. Draw the header band: a light-gray (#EDEDED) rectangle with no outline spanning the full slide width, from the top edge down to ~12% of slide height. 4. Place the title box: a solid dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle with no outline at top-left, spanning ~8-38% of slide width and ~5-15% of slide height (it overlaps the header band and extends ~3% below it); inside it place the bold white (#FFFFFF) sans-serif title 'Classification', approx. 32-36 pt, centered. 5. Place the slide-number badge at the top-right corner of the frame (circle centered at ~94-95% width and ~6-8% height, overlapping the header band): a yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle with a thin dark-red (#8B0000) outline, containing the number '36' in dark-red (#8B0000) text, approx. 14-16 pt, centered. 6. Draw the content box: a white (#FFFFFF) rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) outline (~1.5 pt), spanning ~5-95% of slide width and ~15-95% of slide height. 7. Inside the content box at its top-left, add the subtitle 'Examples of Commonly used classifiers:' in bold red (#C00000) sans-serif text, approx. 22-26 pt, left-aligned. 8. Directly below the subtitle, add one bulleted list occupying the left ~12-45% of slide width: round black bullet markers, black (#000000) regular sans-serif text, approx. 18-22 pt, left-aligned, line spacing ~1.5x, containing exactly 8 items in this order: 'Linear Regression'; 'Logistic Regression'; 'Neural Network'; 'Support Vector Machine'; 'Hidden Markov Model'; 'Decision Trees'; 'Bayesian classifier'; '.......'. 9. Use a single sans-serif font family (e.g., Arial) for all text on the slide. 10. Do NOT recreate the small faint gray (#CCCCCC) circular cursor dot to the right of the 'Logistic Regression' bullet - it is a live screen-recording artifact, not part of the slide design.
